notes: Durations include a small instrumentation cost and use the device millisecond clock.
A begin without an end can also result from rotation, dropped records or abrupt power loss.
Raw function results and IPC delivery do not prove completed hardware transitions.
Device calendar time may be unset; the session also contains a boot-relative start tick.
Event 302 stores interval poll count and maximum poll duration, not a timed operation.
Artwork RAM snapshots are global OS free memory, not per-process ownership.
Bitmap counters track successful instrumented artwork operations while debugging is enabled; pre-existing handles and disabled intervals are not inventoried.
GPS observations contain raw sentence markers, not independently validated checksums or coordinates.
Native parser acceptance is separate from a valid navigation position fix.
Repeated unchanged GPS markers are sampled per bucket every five seconds; changes emit sooner.
Service entry 3746 and 3748 follow different native paths; power-state timing is retained.
A configuration-write acknowledgement does not alone prove retention after restart.
